lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Greetings,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I'm your predecessor.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: What, no response?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Have commanders these days forgotten what manners are?
I don't know you.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: You must have a screw loose.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I've been a commander for over 20 years!

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: You ought to show some respect!
What is your name?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Why do you want to know?
If you outrank me, then I would like to know your name.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: That's on a need-to-know basis,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: and you don't need to know.
I'm blocking you.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: No, wait!

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Hold on!

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Jeez, you're so impatient.
Name. Now.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Ian.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: My name is Ian.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: You don't have to search it in the database.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I assure you that I really was a commander,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: and that I am your predecessor.
What do you want?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: As a veteran in this trade, I wanted to give you a piece of advice.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: That's why I went through the trouble of finding out your contact information.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I heard you are exploring AREA F-031?
Where?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: The place that you're searching right now.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: It's an area which I explored myself many years ago.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I know it like the back of my hand.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Proceed to the coordinates I relay to you,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: and you'll find something interesting.
This all seems a bit suspicious.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: If you don't want to, then forget it.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: It'll be your loss, though.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Later.
